tasks.objective: Map exact artifact/result/verify/reconcile call path with file:line evidence and identify every state transition.
tasks.acceptance: One concise call-path map with no speculative claims.

tasks.objective: Build duplicate/replay failure matrix for result resend, stale result, FAILED retry, STARTED ambiguity and restart.
tasks.acceptance: Each row names identity keys, current behavior, risk, and existing protection.

tasks.objective: Prepare deterministic artifact fixtures for correct/wrong content, newline variance and stale hash.
tasks.acceptance: Fixtures and expected outcomes documented without touching protected runtime.

tasks.objective: Inventory which components can mutate queue/claim/retry/NEXT state and distinguish source presence from live authority.
tasks.acceptance: Authority candidates and required runtime evidence listed.

tasks.objective: Inventory repo assumptions about Muse argv, workspace, yolo, output and session binding.
tasks.acceptance: Expected CLI contract with every assumption marked proven/unproven.

tasks.objective: Prepare deterministic restart checkpoints for RESULT_RECEIVED-before-verify, READY-before-dispatch, STARTED ambiguity and RESULT_READY resend.
tasks.acceptance: Each checkpoint has setup, expected state and failure criteria.

tasks.objective: Find existing reusable repo maps, branch inventories, test inventories and verified findings before proposing new knowledge storage.
tasks.acceptance: Reuse inventory + duplication hotspots.

tasks.objective: Define low-cost measurements for idle CPU, RSS, swap, process spawns/tick and result-to-next latency.
tasks.acceptance: Measurement plan uses existing runtime where possible and adds no busy loop.

tasks.objective: Identify superseded schedulers/walls/helpers that are not needed by the candidate, without deleting anything.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence-backed keep/superseded/unknown map.

tasks.objective: Prepare a runtime-derived Grandma Update template and mapping from technical evidence to ordinary language.
tasks.acceptance: No fake metrics; fields map to real evidence sources.

tasks.objective: Prepare identical deterministic task set for single-task latency and continuation-throughput comparison.
tasks.acceptance: Tasks, expected outputs and metrics specified; no benchmark claims yet.

tasks.objective: Inventory provider/session limits and which facts require physical/account confirmation.
tasks.acceptance: No quota circumvention; unknowns explicit.

tasks.objective: Compare Mac and Windows worker identity/process ownership/restart contracts for semantic drift.
tasks.acceptance: Only actionable cross-platform mismatches reported.

tasks.objective: Design deterministic fixtures for chain A->B->C->D, branch B->C/F and bounded loop F->A.
tasks.acceptance: Each transition has explicit condition, attempt semantics, side-effect rule and loop termination.

tasks.objective: Physically prove a multi-step zero-relay chain after A->B passes.
tasks.acceptance: At least four verified transitions with HUMAN_RELAY_COUNT=0.

tasks.objective: Physically prove one deterministic PASS/FAIL branch chooses exactly one legal successor.
tasks.acceptance: Observed branch matches deterministic evidence and no alternate branch executes.

tasks.objective: Physically prove one bounded safe loop with new attempt identity and explicit termination.
tasks.acceptance: Loop executes only allowed count, no duplicate side effect, deterministic exit.

tasks.objective: Generate compact Proof Cards from canonical runtime evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Every displayed claim traces to evidence IDs and candidate fingerprint.

tasks.objective: Run resource-admitted four-slot canary after restart proof and provider authorization.
tasks.acceptance: No writer conflict, no lost result, no duplicate effect, measured resource headroom.

tasks.objective: Progressively test 8 then 16 logical slots with bounded active work.
tasks.acceptance: Each stage separately admitted and evidence-backed.

tasks.objective: Run bounded 60-120+ minute continuation soak.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated verified NEXT transitions, durable pauses, zero relay except real gates.

tasks.objective: Measure Mac responsiveness while screen recording/music/browser remain active.
tasks.acceptance: Real CPU/RAM/swap/latency evidence; no claim without measurement.

tasks.objective: Create one-command install/start/status/stop after core gates pass.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh supported host completes lifecycle without per-worker prompts.

tasks.objective: Create simple Works/Needs You/Done surface backed only by canonical state.
tasks.acceptance: Grandma Test passes; technical detail remains optional Layer B.
